req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 405 for unsupported HTTP methods on /tasks/{task_id}. The endpoint supports GET, PUT, DELETE. Unsupported methods include POST, PATCH. Tests cover: (1) positive — a supported method (GET) returns 2xx/404 to confirm the endpoint is live; (2) negative — POST to /tasks/{task_id} returns 405 (heuristic NEG); (3) boundary — PATCH to /tasks/{task_id} returns 405 (BVA, semantically adjacent to PUT); (4) positive — PUT supported method not rejected (DT); (5) positive — DELETE supported method not rejected (DT); (6) negative — multiple unsupported methods all return 405. The violation was test[5] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. EP is valid for negative tests when the equivalence class is 'unsupported methods'; however the rule-checker flags this combination. Fix: change heuristic of test[5] from EP to NEG, which is the correct heuristic for negative/error-path tests, while EP is reserved for positive partitioning. All other tests are preserved unchanged.

preconditions: GET is a supported method on /tasks/{task_id}
actions: Send GET /tasks/1 to the in-process TestClient
expected: Response status code is either 200 or 404 (not 405)
Status code is NOT 405 — confirming GET is accepted
trace: R-TASK-026: supported methods must not be rejected with 405
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/1")
assert r.status_code != 405, f"GET should not return 405, got {r.status_code}"
assert r.status_code in (200, 404), f"Expected 200 or 404, got {r.status_code}"

actions: Send POST /tasks/1 with a JSON body to the in-process TestClient
trace: R-TASK-026: HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.post("/tasks/1", json={"title": "x", "completed": False})
assert r.status_code == 405, f"Expected 405, got {r.status_code}"
assert r.status_code != 404
assert r.status_code != 400
assert r.status_code != 200

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
create_r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "orig", "completed": False})
assert create_r.status_code == 201
task_id = create_r.json()["id"]
r = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "updated", "completed": True})
assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200 for PUT, got {r.status_code}"
assert r.status_code != 405

actions: Send POST /tasks/99 to the in-process TestClient
Send PATCH /tasks/99 to the in-process TestClient
trace: R-TASK-026: all unsupported methods must return 405
NEG: negative error-path class — any unsupported method must yield 405
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
unsupported_responses = [
    client.post("/tasks/99", json={"title": "x", "completed": False}),
    client.patch("/tasks/99", json={"title": "y"}),
]
for r in unsupported_responses:
    assert r.status_code == 405, f"Expected 405, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 400
